'''Sago soup''' or '''Sai mai lou''' is a type of [[tong sui]] [[dessert]] in [[Cantonese cuisine]],<ref name="Choo p. 39"/><ref name="Osbeck 1771 p. 72"/><ref name="Dennys 1874 p. 53"/> which is also a variant of [[tapioca pudding]]. It is typically made with [[Tapioca pearl|tapioca pearls]] (sago),  [[coconut milk]] and [[evaporated milk]]. The dish is traditionally prepared using [[sago#Nutrition|sago]] starch, which is derived from sago palm [[pith]].<ref name="Sanmugan 2016 p. 48"/> Other ingredients can also be added, such as [[taro]], [[pumpkin]], [[mango]], etc.<ref name="Sanmugan 2016 p. 48"/>
